summary: Session 2 of 3 delivered: `AccessHarvester identify-cleanup` subcommand implementing the Session 1 strategy. New files: Pipeline/Cleanup/{CleanupFinding,NamePatternDetector,CrossReferenceDetector,DateMaximaSampler,CleanupChecklistWriter,CleanupAnalyser,ComDateMaximaProbe}.cs; Cli/Commands/IdentifyCleanupCommand.cs; Core/Com/AccessDateMaximaSampler.cs; 5 new test files (NamePatternDetectorTests, CrossReferenceDetectorTests, DateMaximaSamplerTests, ComDateMaximaProbeTests, IrLoaderTests). Additive extensions to IrFormOrReport/IrControl/IrTable (Properties dict on form/report/control; LastUpdated/Connect/DateTimeColumnNames on table) and IrLoader population. Dispatcher entry + usage block added to Program.cs. Verification: gpt-5-4 four rounds. R1 ISSUES_FOUND 2 Major + 3 Minor (per-table date fallback, VBA DoCmd parsing, event-property scope, matchedSubstring boundary, test coverage); all fixed. R2 ISSUES_FOUND 2 Major + 2 Minor including a regression in IrLoader (R1 generic-properties branch swallowed Begin macro-action nodes — caught by R2 verifier; reordered + 2 regression tests added) and incomplete COM-failure degradation (extracted ComDateMaximaProbe helper + 5 tests); also narrowed bare-token module/class scan to Call/Set/qualifier contexts and added RowSource tests. All R2 issues fixed. R3 ISSUES_FOUND 2 Minor (missing usage message on dual-flag, contradictory degradation notes); both fixed. R4 (human-authorized override of 2-retry cap, matching Session 1 precedent) VERIFIED. Total verification cost ~$0.82. dotnet build clean; 582/582 tests pass in Pipeline.Tests (+13 new). Smoke test against samples/GoldenOutput/HomeHealthCare validates cleanly against the JSON schema. Pre-existing 3 HomeHealthCare CLI integration test timeouts persist (42/45, unchanged from Session 1 baseline). Architectural deviation documented: DateMaximaSampler.cs is split between Pipeline/Cleanup (interface + DAO fallback per spec) and Core/Com (COM impl) because Core→Pipeline is the existing project-reference direction; Pipeline cannot reference Core.

reason.specifics: Session 3 scope is pilot + calibration — running identify-cleanup against HomeHealthCare and NorthwindDevEdition golden outputs, tuning vocabulary/thresholds/templates, and committing calibrated golden fixtures. This is analysis + light tuning work, matching the repo convention of Sonnet at medium effort for analysis tasks. Recommendation routed via gemini-pro analysis task ($0.0024) confirmed Sonnet as the appropriate cost band; iterative refinement is inherent to this project (4 rounds in both Sessions 1 and 2), not a model-capability issue.
